digest.component_or_area: pytest test infrastructure / temporary directory management
propositions: Nested pytest child processes launched without explicit --basetemp allocate pytest's user-global numbered temp root and delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories at session finish.

tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py::test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active executes a mixed-module reducer test as a nested child without parent-owned basetemp, causing it to join and pollute the shared numbered root.

tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py::test_repro_module_passes_standalone executes a standalone reproduction module as a nested child without parent-owned basetemp, causing the same contamination.
Fix requires passing each nested child a distinct tmp_path-derived --basetemp to isolate cleanup scope from the parent's test fixture lifecycle.

Three existing safe direct launchers already pass parent-owned basetemp; pytester-managed launches inject basetemp via helper; three collect-only launchers never allocate TempPathFactory._basetemp and are not affected.
